Welcome to NIT Andhra Pradesh Placement Discussion! 👋

This group is for discussing every company's OA at NIT Andhra Pradesh: the ones that have already happened here and the ones coming up. Share OA dates, test formats, shortlists and interview experiences so everyone from NIT Andhra Pradesh can prepare together.

Please don't share answers while a test is still live.
